ONE muted burnt-orange #B97049 accent to highlight the single central contribution. Thin precise 1-point neutral lines. All text pure black. Chinese typography like clean printed Heiti, compact, consistent; main labels only modestly larger. NO cartoons, NO illustrations, NO icons, NO pictograms, NO clipart, NO people, NO books, NO paper sheets, NO folded corners, NO computers, NO gears, NO magnifying glass, NO phones, NO cylinders, NO logos, NO gradients, NO shadows, NO 3D, NO big colored title bars, NO glossy shapes. Preserve the semantic relationships below but reinterpret every illustrative object as a compact plain typographic group. Use grouping and alignment, not repeated boxed cards. One visual focal point; secondary mechanisms low visual weight. No decorative title. Prevent text collisions. Do not invent labels or relationships.
